description: This file provides utility functions to convert DOM elements to FileNode instances, create new FileNodes, and check if a node is a FileNode, specifically for integrating file-related functionality within a Lexical editor plugin.

classes.name: FileNode
classes.description: A class representing a file node in a Lexical editor, imported from './FileNode'.

methods.name: convertToFileElement
methods.description: Converts a DOM div element with 'data-lexical-file-uuid' attribute into a Lexical node encapsulated in DOMConversionOutput.

methods.name: $createFileNode
methods.description: Creates a new FileNode instance given a UUID string.

methods.name: $isFileNode
methods.description: Type guard function to check if a given node is an instance of FileNode.
